items.a: 128 PA-715 in Brodheadsville, PA, at the old West End Firehouse. We've turned this local landmark into a brewery where great beer and great company come together.
Sunday to Thursday, 12 PM to 9 PM. Friday and Saturday, 12 PM to 11 PM. Hours are subject to change on major holidays.

items.q: Do you brew your own beer?
items.a: Yes. Brix beer is brewed in-house by our brewmaster. The tap list rotates regularly, so there's always something new next to your favorites. We also pour guest taps from Pennsylvania favorite Weyerbacher.
Yes. John's Chef Table serves sandwiches, shareables, snacks, soups and rotating specials. Pretzels and hotdogs are served all day. Kitchen hours: {{CONFIRM}}.
We do. Besides water, soda, tea and lemonade, we make our own Birch Beer, which has become a local favorite. We also have wine, canned beverages and other non-beer options.
Yes. A flight is four beers, so you can sample a few before you pick a favorite.
Yes. Growler fills are available on many of our beers, depending on what's on tap. We also do crowlers.
Absolutely. Brix is family-friendly, with a kids menu, and we love seeing families here together.
Not at this time, inside or outside. We hope to host dog-friendly events in the future, so stay tuned.

items.q: Do you host live music and events?
items.a: Every week. Live music, trivia, karaoke, open mic nights, watch parties and seasonal events. Taco Tuesday, too.

items.q: Can I book a private party?
items.a: Yes. Eli's Lounge seats 50 and can be rented for celebrations, team nights, fundraisers and group gatherings. Get in touch to talk dates and options.
We're mostly first-come, first-served. If you have a large group, call ahead and we'll do our best to make room.
Yes, in the brewery. They make a great gift for the beer lover in your life.
Yes. Brix shirts, hats, glassware and more. Stop in to see what's available.

items.q: How do I stay up to date?
items.a: Follow us on Facebook and Instagram for live music, food specials, beer releases and community events.

items.q: Who do I contact with a question?
items.a: Stop in, call (570) 213-9298, or email info@brixbrewhouse.com. We're always happy to help.
